# Mount N Muscle

> Owner-operated home services across the Charlotte, NC metro — junk removal, moving, hauling, TV mounting, flooring, and handyman work. Published rates, free quotes, same-day response.

## Contact
- Phone / text: 704-237-0164
- Website: https://mountnmuscle.com
- Base: Steele Creek, Charlotte, NC 28278
- Google listing: https://maps.google.com/?cid=1061662564359275114

## Junk removal — priced by the space the load takes
- 16ft enclosed trailer (~15 cu yd packed): single item $95 · 1/8 $150 · 1/4 $235 · 3/8 $315 · 1/2 $395 · 5/8 $475 · 3/4 $560 · full $700
- 6x10 utility trailer (~8.4 cu yd packed): single item $95 · quarter $170 · half $230 · packed to the rails $335
- 5x8 utility trailer (~6 cu yd packed): single item $95 · quarter $145 · half $210 · packed to the rails $285
- Surcharges: mattress or box spring +$25 each · refrigerant appliance +$40 · tire +$8 · paint, e-waste and regulated items at disposal cost

## TV mounting — flat rate
- Up to 60" $99 · 61–75" $149 · 76–85" $199 · 86" and up from $299 (two-person minimum) · over fireplace, stone or brick from $199 · each additional TV in the same visit 25% off mount labor (add-ons excluded)
- Add-ons: stick-on cord concealment $39 · in-wall cord concealment from $89 · flat mount supplied and installed $40 · full-motion mount supplied and installed $65

## Labor and crews
- Solo labor / handyman $70/hr ($140 minimum)
- Two-person crew $135/hr ($270 minimum)
- Trailer add-on to any crew rate: utility trailer +$25/hr · 16ft enclosed +$60/hr
- Two-hour minimum on all hourly work, 30-minute increments after. Saturday and Sunday two-person crew bookings carry a three-hour minimum ($405, or $585 with the 16ft trailer) and no weekend surcharge. Solo handyman keeps the two-hour minimum every day.

## Flooring
- LVP / laminate $2.50/sq ft · herringbone or premium pattern $3.50/sq ft · tear-out and haul $0.50/sq ft · subfloor prep $70/hr
- Minimum 200 sq ft or $500

## Travel
- Zone 1 no fee: Charlotte (S/SW), Steele Creek, Pineville, Lake Wylie, Tega Cay
- Zone 2 +$29: Fort Mill, Ballantyne, Mount Holly, central Charlotte
- Zone 3 +$49: Rock Hill, Gastonia, Matthews, Stallings, Indian Trail, Waxhaw, Huntersville
- Zone 4 +$89: Concord, Mooresville
- Hauling adds $3.00 per loaded mile beyond the first 10

## Other add-ons
- Stairs +$25 per flight above the first · heavy or awkward item from +$40 · same-day or emergency +$40 · Sunday +15% on flat-rate jobs only, never on hourly crew work
- Card payments carry a 3.5% processing fee. Cash, check, and Zelle also accepted.

## Promotions
One promotion per booking — discounts never stack. WELCOME10 gives 10% off a first booking for residents of partner properties.

## Referrals
Friends & Neighbors referral credit — $25 credit to whoever refers and $25 off the new customer's first booking. Anyone counts: friends, neighbors, family, coworkers. Three booked referrals earns $100 credit or a free hour of solo labor. Property managers and realtor teams get custom account rates.

## Policies
- Every quote is free and confirmed before work starts
- Cancel or reschedule free with 24 hours' notice
- We cannot haul hazardous chemicals, asbestos, ammunition, or heavy fill like concrete and dirt
- Reviews live on the Google Business Profile; no discounts are offered in exchange for reviews
